transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Monkey! You useless, flea-bitten ape! The horse is gone, the scripture-bags are gone, and the Master is weeping! You said you'd secure it before you left! Tripitaka is going to blame me, I just know it!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Calm down, Pigsy! I'll find them, don't you worry. The horse is just a stubborn mule, it can't have gone far. I'll leap to the highest treetops and scope the area. You stay here and comfort the Master; he's likely in a tizzy. I'll be back before you can finish a bowl of porridge!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Oh, that's rich coming from you, Wukong! Always so quick to leap away and leave the mess behind! It's easy for you to slip away, but when it comes to facing Tripitaka's wrath, who gets the blame? Me, that's who! You'd better find that horse and the scriptures fast, or I'll never hear the end of it!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Blowhole! Pigsy, you're worse than a freckled, flat-nosed piglet! I'll find them, I'll find them! In and out of your own ears, I'll have the horse back in no time flat. Mark my words, if you don't shut your yap, you'll find yourself doubled over! Now, hold your snout, while I set to the task!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Oh, don't you start with the insults, Wukong! If you were half as disciplined as you are loud-mouthed, we wouldn't be in this mess! You better return with the horse and scriptures, or I'll make sure Tripitaka knows whose fault this really is! I'll hold my tongue, but you best keep your promise this time!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You've riled up the猴儿（ape）, Pigsy! I'll find them, and I'll be back before you can say 'flying leap'! Now, you take care of the Master, and I'll take care of the horse and the bags. transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Sure, sure, off you go then! But I'm telling you, if you return empty-handed, I'll have a few choice words for you! Tripitaka needs some comforting, and let's be honest, I'm better at managing meals than mending moods. But I'll do what I can while you're away. Just be quick and don't dawdle, you hear me?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Hear you? I'll hear you later, when we're all in trouble for this! Enough of your grumbling, Pigsy. I'll be back before you can count to three! Remember, if Tripitaka asks, you're the one who tied the horse securely. We're in this together, and together we'll fix it. Now, hold your snout, and I'll get to it!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I'll count to three, but you'd better make it back in one! If we're in this together, then get on with it, Monkey! And don't think I'll let you off the hook easily if we're still in hot water. Now stop yammering and start searching! The Master won’t wait forever.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Trick-footed hog! I'll find them, you'll see! Mark my words, Pigsy, if I don't return in time, you'll have to eat your own tail! Now, stop your blabbering and keep your eye on the Master. I'm off, and I'll be back before you can say 'bamboo pole'!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Fine, fine, off you go then! If you actually manage to do something right for once, maybe I won't have to resort to eating my tail! transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Patience? You, Pigsy? I'll be back before you can say 'Monkey's tail'! Keep the Master calm, and don't let him suspect a thing. I'll be back with the horse and the bags, and we'll be on our way in no time!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: We'll see about that, Monkey! I'll keep Tripitaka calm for now, but you better deliver on your promise this time. If not, you'll be dealing with more than just my bellyaching. Now hurry up before the Master catches on that something's wrong!

transcript.text: Scram! I'm off to find the horse and the bags. You watch over the Master and don't let him suspect a thing. I'll be back before you can say 'taut bowstring'! Now, enough chatter, I must go!
